lists.name: sample-malware
lists.description: Hand-authored placeholder proving the block_lists ingestion pipeline end-to-end. Not a real threat feed and NOT refreshable: it records no upstream URL, so `fak egresslist refresh` reports it skipped rather than inventing a provenance. The real community feeds (StevenBlack hosts, EasyPrivacy, URLhaus) arrive with the ingestion issue and land here with a real url + last_refreshed.
